name: Desert Tortoise Council Regular Grants Program
summary: Grants from the Desert Tortoise Council for activities and research that benefit desert tortoises and their habitats, and other imperiled tortoises, turtles and ecosystems.

status.quote: Regular Grants Program continuously open review and response times may vary

applicant_types.quote: The Desert Tortoise Council will consider Grant Requests from qualified individuals or organizations for research or other activities on topics related to the biology, conservation, or management of desert tortoises

access.quote: Grants Request Policy Grants Request Cover Form

window.quote: Regular Grants Program continuously open review and response times may vary

effort.quote: All Grant Requests must be submitted electronically in portable document format (.PDF) to: grants@deserttortoise.org.
The Grants Committee will review each Grant Request for completeness prior to the Grants Committee Chairperson forwarding the request for Board consideration.
For complete Grant Requests, the Grants Committee will provide their recommendation to the Board for consideration for funding.
A majority vote, by a quorum of the Board participating in the consideration of the Grant Request during a scheduled meeting, will determine if the project will be supported.

documents.quote: A detailed description of the proposed research or activity.
A detailed budget that itemizes funds to be used for labor and non-labor expenses must be included.
Names and contact information for three professional references. 4. Résumés of all key participants, highlighting current and past relevant experience.
